invariant: Parameter command selection occurs on the hidden stream and must satisfy the complete family grammar before consuming any body or mutating style. Numeric size and color grammars reject hidden markers and invalid punctuation; a failed candidate leaves the iterator for one literal-character consumption. Family/image payload grammars intentionally admit more than size/color; no blanket private-use-character ban or URL rewrite. Combined font attributes have priority over broad family fallback. Selected commands preserve flush boundaries and recursive hiding.
causal_divergence: Prefix-only guards select malformed sizes even when integer conversion fails and copy invalid hidden colors into Style.fill. The same permissive recognition exists for other parameter families. Font branches also confuse combined attributes with family fallback, and font: forces monospace although Java changeFamily only selects a family. Existing closing collectors do not honor Java case-insensitive parameter closers.
planned_change: In creole.rs only, introduce private typed parameter candidates backed by the named anchored Java grammars for size, color, combined font attributes, font family, parameterized background, image and icon. Preserve existing strict sprite grammar. Dispatch parameter semantics from captured fields; preserve Java combined-font-before-family priority, last repeated attribute capture, and source-defined bounded/EOL case-insensitive closes. Reuse private flush barriers and hidden recursion. Do not modify URL handling, legacy tspan, public Style/TextBase APIs, WBS/model/geometry, negative serialization or font assets/metrics. Image loading and icon resolution remain their existing owners. Plain/code are explicitly deferred: changing registry/reset semantics is a separate mechanism and base-style reset cannot be generally represented by the current public boolean inheritance without coordinated API scope.
